summary: Contributor and agent guidance now covers the full delivery loop, from issue and milestone tracking through release and deploy; nothing changes for members.
detailed_changes: AGENTS.md describes one required loop: issue, version milestone and sub-issues at the start; commit, PR, green CI, merge, tagged release and Cloudron deploy at the end (#562).
A new docs/agent-workflow.md runbook lists the exact GitHub CLI commands for each step (#562).
The Cursor Cloud agent image installs the GitHub CLI (#562).
Pull request and issue templates ask for the parent issue and target milestone, and the PR template carries a post-merge release and deploy checklist (#562).
Issue template assignees and CODEOWNERS point at the current maintainer account (#562).
affected_areas: Internal impact: AGENTS.md, docs/agent-workflow.md, .cursor/Dockerfile, .github PR and issue templates, CODEOWNERS
